artemisininCheck.explanation: Descriptor rdkit (logP 2.40). Endoperoxide heat flag: True. Cold water 0.27 [0.03–0.78]; decoction 0.05 (heat factor 0.23); low-temperature hexane 0.79 [0.23–0.98]. Pre-registered thresholds: cold water < 0.3, nonpolar > 0.6. Exploratory xTB Wiberg bond order of the O–O bond: 0.944. BORDERLINE: the 5th–95th percentile range crosses a threshold (cold water 0.03–0.78 vs < 0.3; nonpolar 0.23–0.98 vs > 0.6). Cold water is filtered (filtration factor 1.00): its value comes from the solvent factor alone. Without straining, the suspension assumption raises it to 0.41 (filtration factor 1.42).
